name: Daridorexant

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS CNS-Depressant Effects and Daytime Impairment: Impairs alertness and motor coordination including morning impairment. Risk increases when used with other central nervous system (CNS) depressants. For patients taking QUVIVIQ, caution against next-day driving and other activities requiring…

summary: Warnings for Daridorexant show it can decrease daytime alertness and muscle coordination, including in the morning, which raises risks during next-day driving and similar activities. [3] This danger goes up when it is taken alongside other drugs that slow down brain activity. [3] Additionally, a small computer model rather than testing on people estimated a medium risk score of 58 for the liver and a low risk score of 32 for the heart. [M]
